note: Curated by hand. A ticker that is not in the IDX universe is dropped by the build and counted, never invented.

themes.label: BANKS & LENDERS
themes.note: The biggest weight in the IDX and the cleanest read on domestic credit. Net interest margin and the provisioning cycle drive earnings, so these names carry a P/E and a P/B but no free cash flow — a bank's cash flow statement is loans and deposits, not a business.

themes.label: NICKEL & BATTERY METALS
themes.note: Indonesia is the world's largest nickel producer, and the battery chain runs through these names: laterite mines, ferronickel and matte smelters, and the copper-gold porphyries that come with them. A nickel price move reaches the equity before it reaches the index.

themes.label: COAL, OIL & ENERGY
themes.note: The thermal-coal exporters that supply China and India, plus the oil and gas names and the heavy-equipment dealer that serves the mines. Coal cash flow is cyclical and dividend-heavy; the oil names are more sensitive to crude and the rupiah.

themes.label: PALM OIL & PLANTATIONS
themes.note: The upstream palm growers. CPO is priced in dollars and the cost base is in rupiah, so a weaker rupiah flatters the margin; export levies and Indonesia's domestic-market obligation are the policy swing factors.

themes.label: CONSUMER & RETAIL
themes.note: The domestic demand story: staples, noodles, dairy, poultry, convenience retail and the mall operators. These are the names that read the rupiah through input costs and the consumer through volumes.

themes.label: TELCO & DIGITAL
themes.note: The mobile operators, the tower owner and the two loss-making internet platforms. Telco is a cash-flow and dividend story; the platforms are an option on Indonesian e-commerce, priced on revenue rather than profit.

themes.label: INFRASTRUCTURE & CONSTRUCTION
themes.note: Toll roads, construction and the state-linked builders. Order books and the government budget drive the cycle; leverage and receivables are the risk. A weaker rupiah raises imported material costs.

themes.label: PROPERTY
themes.note: Developers and the mall/office owners. The read is presales, inventory and mortgage rates; the balance sheet is the story, which is why P/B matters more here than P/E.

themes.label: HEALTHCARE
themes.note: Pharmaceutical makers, hospitals and the consumer-health names. A defensive, domestic sector with a long growth runway and little commodity exposure — useful as a hedge against the mining and energy weights.

themes.label: AUTOS & COMPONENTS
themes.note: The assemblers, the motorcycle/auto parts makers and the tyre producers. Volumes track domestic demand and rates; costs track the rupiah and steel. Astra is also a proxy for the whole conglomerate economy.
